decision_statement: V012 NEXT closes as a valid descriptive and traceability experiment. Its observed fixed-action pattern does not discriminate the hypothesized action-conditioned future-space mechanism from stable action preference. Q1 and Q5 therefore remain unresolved at the mechanism-discrimination level. A subsequent design is scientifically required only if the programme is to distinguish these remaining alternatives; the present result is not treated as TGCV-wide falsification or confirmation.

next_design_requirement.required_direction: Introduce a new independently identifying manipulation in which the competing explanatory mechanisms generate distinguishable predictions while preserving the decision-before-realized-future boundary and avoiding normative, reward, utility, value, performance, or task-success encoding.
